title: New York State Pension Fund Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake by More Than 10%
summary: Bitcoin Magazine New York State Pension Fund Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake by More Than 10% New York's state pension fund raised its Strategy (MSTR) stake to 352,850 shares worth $54.0 million at Sept. 30, a gain of more than 10% from June 30, its latest 13F shows. This post New York State Pension Fund Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake by More Than 10% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
